name: Bolt
tagline: Prompt, run and deploy full-stack apps in the browser
description: Bolt (bolt.new) is a browser-based AI app builder with token-based usage on Free, Pro, Teams and Enterprise plans.
features: Monthly AI token allowance per plan
File uploads (10 MB on Free, 100 MB on paid)
strengths: Free forever with no card required
Unused tokens roll over on Pro
limitations: Free plan has a daily token limit of 300K and 1M tokens per month
Annual per-month prices were not captured

plans.name: Pro
highlights: 10M monthly tokens, unused tokens roll over

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom annual contract, billed by consumption

free.details: 1M monthly AI tokens, 300K daily token limit, 333K web requests per month and a 10 MB file upload limit. Unused tokens do not roll over.

pricing.regional: A yearly toggle shows 'Save up to 28%' but yearly prices were not captured. The page shows '$' without naming the currency.

verification.notes: Product active (AI app and website builder). Free $0, Pro $25/month billed monthly, Teams $30/member/month billed monthly, Enterprise custom annual contract. A yearly toggle (save up to 28%) exists; yearly prices were not read. Pro now lists 10M tokens/month with rollover, 100 MB uploads, 1M web requests per month; the page says taxes are extra.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read
